messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000761": A partner asked for webhook key rotation in their security review.  (about: webhook dispatcher, partner)
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000575": INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000758" [decision]: The Boreal team decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000710": INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000215" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000581" [decision]: Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review.  (about: INC-2025-017, certificate expiry)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000579": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000714": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex jobs)
- memory_id "1000434": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011, the schema migration)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000951" [decision]: As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000838": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team reported that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000185": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000171" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000877" [decision]: As of 2025-12-18, the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000336": In the product catalog, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000190": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so the webhook dispatcher is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000771": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team saw that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it as not their service.  (about: Ember team, the marketing send, billing service)
Existing entity names: webhook dispatcher, partner, ledger service, INC-2025-011, auth gateway, INC-2025-017, Boreal team, indexer, INC-2025-023, notifier, push provider, certificate expiry, reindex jobs, the schema migration, Cinder team, billing API, the dependency bump, the bus, product catalog, Ember team, the marketing send, billing service

The note:

[2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Follow-up decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
